## Checklist
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated; deterministic and hermetic (no network, sleeps, or wall clock)
- [ ] `./gradlew spotlessApply` run
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`) — DCO
- [ ] No change weakens a Risk Manager invariant or makes the deterministic layer nondeterministic
